# abslife

> Under construction!

The goal of abslife is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of abslife like so:

``` r

remotes::install_github("lcgodoy/abslife")
```

## Example

``` r

library(abslife)
#> Welcome to the abslife package!
```

What is special about using `README.Rmd` instead of just `README.md`?
You can include R chunks like so:

``` r

data(aloans)
summary(aloans)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`aart`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/aart.md) : Consumer
  automobile loans from Ally Auto Receivables Trust

- [`aloans`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/aloans.md) : Consumer
  automobile loans dataset

- [`aloans_recov`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/aloans_recov.md)
  : Consumer automobile loans recovery curves

- [`amort_bal()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/amort_bal.md) :
  Calculates a full loan amortization schedule

- [`calc_cdf()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/calc_cdf.md) :
  Calculates the cumulative distribution function (CDF) from estimated
  hazard rates

- [`calc_cif()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/calc_cif.md) :
  Calculate Cumulative Incidence Functions (CIF) from estimated hazard
  rates

- [`calc_osup()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/calc_osup.md) :
  Calculate Observed Support

- [`calculate_apv()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/calculate_apv.md)
  : Calculates the actuarial present value (APV) of a loan

- [`disc_fac()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/disc_fac.md) :
  Calculate discount factors for an effective interest rate

- [`estimate_hazard()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/estimate_hazard.md)
  : Estimating the discrete time, hazard rate subject to left-truncation

- [`ev_life()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/ev.md) : Calculates
  expected value from an estimated lifetime distribution

- [`extend_hazard()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/extend_hazard.md)
  : Extrapolate hazard rates beyond observable region

- [`ggauto()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/ggauto.md) :

  Plots an `alife` (or `alife_multi`) object with `ggplot2`

- [`mbalt`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/mbalt.md) : Consumer
  automobile leases from Mercedes-Benz Auto Lease Trust 2017-A

- [`plot(`*`<acdf>`*`)`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/plot_cdf.md)
  [`plot(`*`<acif>`*`)`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/plot_cdf.md)
  [`plot(`*`<acdf_multi>`*`)`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/plot_cdf.md)
  :

  Plot method for an `acdf`, `acdf_multi`, or `acif` object

- [`plot(`*`<alife>`*`)`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/plots.md)
  [`plot(`*`<alife_multi>`*`)`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/plots.md)
  :

  Plot method for an `alife` or `alife_multi` object

- [`prep_ggplot()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/prep_ggplot.md)
  :

  Prepares an `alife` or `alife_multi` object for `ggauto`

- [`ralife()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/ralife.md) :
  Generates a random sample from an estimated lifetime distribution

- [`retrieve_support()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/retrieve_support.md)
  : Dimensions of Observable Support

- [`solve_irr()`](http://lcgodoy.me/abslife/reference/solve_irr.md) :
  Solves for the risk-adjusted internal rate of return (IRR)
